features.f1_body: A fully native Slint vector UI driving the sound card through cpal (CoreAudio / WASAPI / PipeWire). No Web, no Wasm, no AudioWorklet — therefore no GC clicks and no sandbox latency tax.
features.f2_body: Every position is an integer tick. 960 divides by 2/3/4/5/6/8/12/16, so binary and triplet grids are exact and note positions never accumulate floating-point drift.
features.f3_body: Persistent state uses ordered containers only, so iteration order is identical across processes and restarts. Parallel bus summing reduces in a stable key order, eliminating low-bit drift from float non-associativity.
features.f4_body: Both the musical intent protocol and the UI introspection protocol bind to loopback only, are off by default, and authenticate every request. Every AI edit is a reversible atomic operation, never an unexplained overwrite.
features.f4_title: An interface designed for AI collaboration
features.f5_body: Edits reduce to a domain operation log; undo is reverse replay. Editing after going back grows an anonymous branch, so discarded history is preserved in full and can be revisited at any time.
features.f6_body: Released under GPLv3 with the GPLv3 §7 exception for dynamic loading of proprietary CLAP plug-ins. Third-party dependencies pass a mechanical licence audit, and non-commercial assets never enter the repository.
features.f6_title: Open to the core, with clear licensing

hero.subtitle: Yeban is a from-scratch native desktop DAW: a declarative Slint vector interface on top of a pure-Rust low-latency audio engine. No browser sandbox, no GC-induced clicks, no legacy baggage.
hero.title: Give composition back to music, and determinism back to engineering

oss.agent_body: Specifications, gates and working discipline all exist in machine-executable form: requirement IDs, criteria that can fail, and legal files agents must never touch.
oss.agent_title: An engineering contract written for human–AI collaboration
oss.audit_body: Every dependency must pass an allow-list licence check. Non-commercial restrictions, proprietary non-redistributable terms and GPLv3-incompatible licences are blocked by an automated gate.
oss.docs_body: The architecture spec, engineering roadmap, UI spec and research report are all public. Conflicts between specs are resolved in writing, not by convention.
oss.gpl_body: The project is released under GPLv3 with the §7 exception that allows proprietary CLAP plug-ins to load. Forks distributed as closed source must obtain a commercial Slint licence.
oss.subtitle: A free-software promise has to live in executable mechanisms, not only in a licence file.
oss.title: Open source and governance
roadmap.p1_body: Licence allow-list, dependency audit, legal and trademark checks, repository cleanup.
roadmap.p2_body: Driver latency, lock-free channels, render frame rate, invertible data model, headless capture and snapshot exchange.
roadmap.p3_body: Project container, atomic save, file locking and deterministic migration.
roadmap.p4_body: Direct driver access, internal latency compensation, sampler and the first sounding slice.
roadmap.p5_body: Session/arrangement twins, 100k-note virtualised piano roll, A/B blind switching and accessibility.
roadmap.p6_body: Dual-protocol automation loop, offline mastering, GPLv3 distribution and full gate cut-over.

roadmap.subtitle: Progress is measured in mechanically verifiable capability slices, each gated by hard release gates.
